# How game works

#### Course: Game Logic with JavaScript

## How game works

A game is a program that does a few things over and over:

- show something
- get input
- update state
- repeat

Our quiz works the same way. It shows a question, gets your answer, updates the score, then moves to the next question. That loop is the heart of the game.

Important: Before we write that loop, we need one simple tool: a way to show text on the screen. In our case, the "screen" is the console.
